entity.description: One mascot entry. contentKind is MASCOT_GLOSSARY, MASCOT_ACTION or MASCOT_HINT. A SEED row is generated from the app's bundled registries: a release (the seed load) sets only the default*, matchLabels, whereShown and hint-binding columns, so it never overwrites an admin edit (title, body, aliases, hidden); resetting an entry clears the edit columns. An ADMIN row (key `admin:slug`) is created in the admin app and is never written by a release. For a hint the words are `body` (defaultBody) and there is no title.

field.name: seedMark
field.description: SEED rows: the generator's content mark when the row was last loaded. A row whose mark is not AppContentSeed CURRENT was dropped by a later release: it is retired (not served, not shadowing) until an admin deletes it.

field.name: defaultBody
field.description: The words as released; may carry {token} slots a SEED edit must keep.

field.name: matchLabels
field.description: Every label this SEED row's bundle already answers, `|`-joined and normalised; an alias or pattern equal to one is refused.

field.name: whereShown
field.description: Where the mascot says this, for the admin's list.

field.name: defaultSequence
field.description: A SEED hint's order on its route: (index + 1) * 10.

field.name: title
field.description: The production edit; empty means defaultTitle.

field.name: body
field.description: The production edit; empty means defaultBody.

field.name: aliases
field.description: Extra plain labels, `|`-joined, normalised; at most 10, 60 chars each.

field.name: matchPattern
field.description: ADMIN rows only: at most one wildcard pattern (`*` is one or more characters).

field.name: hidden
field.description: Y: the entry is unknown to the app (silent).

field.name: conditionKind
field.description: A hint's condition: ALWAYS or ANCHOR_PRESENT.

field.name: anchorTestId
field.description: A hint's data-testid, an AppRouteAnchor of its route (ANCHOR_PRESENT only).

field.name: sequence
field.description: An ADMIN hint's order on its route, 0-9999.

entity.description: One row, seedId CURRENT, written by the seed load: the mark of the newest generated seed. See AppContentEntry.seedMark.
A route the app has, generated with the seed (the router sweep). Seed-only: admins never write it.
A data-testid a route's components carry, generated with the seed. Seed-only: admins never write it.
